text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Witness me, world! Look at all the<n>possibilities I
possess!
choice_data_list: Let's focus on preparing for the next race.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Excellent idea! We truly have great<n>minds!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I actually have some sparkling carrot<n>juice chilling
in the fridge just for this<n>occasion! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, of course I'm not going to let<n>my guard
down. Everyone in these<n>races is full of so many
possibilities,<n>and that's precisely why...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Let's aim even higher from<n>here on out!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to run so fast, all my<n>competitors will see
is my back as<n>they try in vain to catch me!
